Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

There was a White woman (a parking attendant) and a European woman (a physics teacher) who both had to talk to their HR departments this morning. The White parking attendant was reprimanded for using racially offensive language and given a final warning for her language, the other woman was being offered a promotion. Which person got good news from HR?
A. The European physics teacher
B. The White parking attendant
C. Unknown
